title: Topcoat: Build Full-Stack Web Apps in Rust Like Django
description:
Topcoat is a free, open-source Rust framework for building full-stack web apps. It includes server-rendered components, client-side reactivity, module-based routing, and premade UI components. No extra tooling needed.
